FurnitureItem.title: FurnitureItem
FurnitureItem.description: A sofa or furniture product listed in the PAGRA showroom catalog.

name.description: Display name of the furniture piece

imageUrl.description: Image path, URL, or compressed data URI for the item

dimensions.description: Physical dimensions of the furniture piece

isOnSale.description: Whether the item is currently marked on promotional sale

salePrice.description: Promotional sale price in KES when on sale

saleLabel.description: Optional promotional label for sale items

createdBy.description: UID of the administrator who created the item

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when item was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when item was last updated

Category.title: Category
Category.description: A furniture category used for filtering and organizing PAGRA products.

name.description: Display title of the furniture category

description.description: Short editorial summary of the category

createdBy.description: UID of the administrator who created the category

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when category was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when category was last updated

AdminGrant.title: AdminGrant
AdminGrant.description: An access control record granting administrator privileges to a user.

uid.description: Target administrator UID or deterministic identifier

addedBy.description: UID of the administrator who granted privileges

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin privilege was granted

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when admin privilege was last updated

CustomerReview.title: CustomerReview
CustomerReview.description: A public customer review and rating for a PAGRA furniture item.

authorName.description: Public display name of the reviewer

authorLocation.description: City or neighbourhood of the reviewer (e.g. Karen, Nairobi)

itemName.description: Name of the PAGRA furniture piece reviewed

createdBy.description: UID of the authenticated user who submitted the review

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when review was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when review was last updated

/items/{itemId}.description: Publicly readable catalog of PAGRA furniture items; write operations restricted strictly to verified administrators.

/categories/{categoryId}.description: Publicly readable list of furniture categories; write operations restricted strictly to verified administrators.

/admins/{adminId}.description: PII-isolated administrator role grants; read/write restricted strictly to the record owner or verified administrators.

/reviews/{reviewId}.description: Publicly readable customer reviews; creation restricted to verified authenticated users; deletion restricted to review author or administrators.
